Twisting is not separately budgeted: it is paid for out of the same capacity that measures distance between subspaces. cards.title: B2 — Normality is exactly commutation.

cards.explanation: Split any real operator into its symmetric and skew parts. They commute precisely when the operator is normal, and the departure from normality is exactly twice their commutator. cards.title: B207 — The doubled Schwarzschild slice reads as the two books of one scalar edge.

cards.explanation: To prove rigidity, the Penrose-inequality argument doubles the static slice with the conformal factors ((1 ± λ)/2)⁴. On the isotropic Schwarzschild slice one sheet is flat space and the other is its image under the inversion ρ ↦ a²/ρ. Read (1, λ) as a scalar edge: (1 ± λ)/2 are the half-amplitudes of its two books, λ is the tanh of half a log-ratio, and the inversion is the sign flip that swaps the books.
